rows.label: SIGHT BILL
rows.clue: A draft payable on presentation

rows.label: ALLOCATION
rows.clue: A share set aside for a specific purpose

rows.label: CHEAP MONEY
rows.clue: Credit available at low rates of interest

rows.label: FOOD STAMP
rows.clue: A government-issued stamp that can be used in exchange for food

rows.label: PAY PACKET
rows.clue: Wages enclosed in an envelope for distribution to the wage earner

rows.label: GIFT
rows.clue: Something acquired without compensation

rows.label: METAL MONEY
rows.clue: Coins collectively

rows.label: DEBIT
rows.clue: An accounting entry acknowledging sums that are owing

rows.label: STAMP TAX
rows.clue: A tax collected by requiring a stamp to be purchased and attached (usually on documents or publications)

rows.label: LIFE ESTATE
rows.clue: (law) an estate whose duration is limited to the life of the person holding it

rows.label: LEGAL FEE
rows.clue: A fee paid for legal service

rows.label: SAVINGS
rows.clue: A fund of money put by as a reserve

rows.label: COLLATERAL
rows.clue: A security pledged for the repayment of a loan

rows.label: PAWN
rows.clue: An article deposited as security

rows.label: HEIRLOOM
rows.clue: (law) any property that is considered by law or custom as inseparable from an inheritance is inherited with that inheritance

rows.label: STRIKE PAY
rows.clue: Money paid to strikers from union funds

rows.label: EFFECTS
rows.clue: Property of a personal character that is portable but not used in business

rows.label: SALES
rows.clue: Income (at invoice values) received for goods and services over some given period of time

rows.label: SALES TAX
rows.clue: A tax based on the cost of the item purchased and collected directly from the buyer

rows.label: CAPITAL
rows.clue: Assets available for use in the production of further assets

rows.label: DOOR PRIZE
rows.clue: Tickets are passed out at the entrance to a dance or party or other social function and a prize is awarded to the holder of the winning ticket

rows.label: PRIZE MONEY
rows.clue: Any money given as a prize

rows.label: IMPORT DUTY
rows.clue: A duty imposed on imports

rows.label: FREIGHT RATE
rows.clue: The charge for transporting something by common carrier

rows.label: FINE
rows.clue: Money extracted as a penalty

rows.label: DONATION
rows.clue: A voluntary gift (as of money or service or ideas) made to some worthwhile cause

rows.label: BANK RATE
rows.clue: The discount rate fixed by a central bank

rows.label: FUNDING
rows.clue: Financial resources provided to make some project possible

rows.label: DIVIDEND
rows.clue: That part of the earnings of a corporation that is distributed to its shareholders

rows.label: CASH
rows.clue: Money in the form of bills or coins

rows.label: FREEBIE
rows.clue: Something that is free (usually provided as part of a promotional scheme)

rows.label: PROPERTY
rows.clue: Something owned

rows.label: EXCISE
rows.clue: A tax that is measured by the amount of business done (not on property or income from real estate)

rows.label: SEED MONEY
rows.clue: Capital needed to set up a new business or enterprise

rows.label: OFFER PRICE
rows.clue: (stock market) the price at which a broker is willing to sell a certain security

rows.label: PENNY STOCK
rows.clue: A stock selling for less that $1/share

rows.label: CASH ADVANCE
rows.clue: An amount paid before it is earned

rows.label: GASOLINE TAX
rows.clue: A tax on every gallon of gasoline sold

rows.label: TARE
rows.clue: An adjustment made for the weight of the packaging in order to determine the net weight of the goods

rows.label: SLUSH FUND
rows.clue: A fund for buying votes or bribing public officials

rows.label: SPOT PRICE
rows.clue: The current delivery price of a commodity traded in the spot market

rows.label: ECONOMIC AID
rows.clue: Money to support a worthy person or cause

rows.label: FEE SIMPLE
rows.clue: A fee without limitation to any class of heirs

rows.label: BAD CHECK
rows.clue: A check that is dishonored on presentation because of insufficient funds

rows.label: TARIFF
rows.clue: A government tax on imports or exports

rows.label: POSTAGE
rows.clue: The charge for mailing something

rows.label: MONEY SUPPLY
rows.clue: The total stock of money in the economy

rows.label: SLICE
rows.clue: A share of something

rows.label: ROYALTY
rows.clue: Payment to the holder of a patent or copyright or resource for the right to use their property

rows.label: ALIMONY
rows.clue: Court-ordered support paid by one spouse to another after they are separated

rows.label: HOARD
rows.clue: A secret store of valuables or money

rows.label: LEVY
rows.clue: A charge imposed and collected

rows.label: AUDIT
rows.clue: An inspection of the accounting procedures and records by a trained accountant or CPA

rows.label: DEEP POCKET
rows.clue: A source of substantial wealth (usually plural)

rows.label: TIGHT MONEY
rows.clue: The economic condition in which credit is difficult to secure and interest rates are high

rows.label: RESOURCE
rows.clue: Available source of wealth

rows.label: INCOME
rows.clue: The financial gain (earned or unearned) accruing over a given period of time

rows.label: FOOD BANK
rows.clue: A place where food is contributed and made available to those in need

rows.label: SEED CORN
rows.clue: Good quality seeds (as kernels of corn) that are reserved for planting

rows.label: CUSTOMS
rows.clue: Money collected under a tariff

rows.label: LETTER BOND
rows.clue: A bond that has not been registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission and cannot be sold to the general public

rows.label: PROPRIETARY
rows.clue: An unincorporated business owned by a single person who is responsible for its liabilities and entitled to its profits

rows.label: HONORARIUM
rows.clue: A fee paid for a nominally free service

rows.label: SWEAT EQUITY
rows.clue: Interest in a building that a tenant earns by contributing to its renovation or maintenance

rows.label: SHIP MONEY
rows.clue: An impost levied in England to provide money for ships for national defense

rows.label: PEANUTS
rows.clue: An insignificant sum of money

rows.label: CASH CARD
rows.clue: A credit card that entitles the holder to receive cash

rows.label: EASY MONEY
rows.clue: Income obtained with a minimum of effort

rows.label: LETTER STOCK
rows.clue: Stock that has not been registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission and cannot be sold to the general public

rows.label: QUICK BUCK
rows.clue: Quick or easy earnings, "they are traders out to make a fast buck"

rows.label: ASSETS
rows.clue: Anything of material value or usefulness that is owned by a person or company

rows.label: CAPITAL COST
rows.clue: The opportunity cost of the funds employed as the result of an investment decision

rows.label: BUDGET
rows.clue: A sum of money allocated for a particular purpose
